meta.title: Snaker — Online selling, made simpler
meta.description: Create and manage your online store without complicated software or unnecessary costs.

hero.description: Create and manage your online store without complicated software or unnecessary costs. Products, payments, and orders in one place.

intro.label: THE APPROACH
intro.title: Running your store shouldn't feel like running software.
intro.lead: Most business owners want to focus on their products and their customers. Traditional ecommerce platforms make you configure plugins, manage multiple subscriptions, and troubleshoot technical issues before you can even take an order.

pillars.simplicityBody: Add products in moments, adjust prices, and fulfill customer orders from a clean interface designed for daily retail operations.
pillars.affordabilityBody: Start with what your business needs today and scale as you grow. No mandatory third-party app fees to unlock basic retail functions.
pillars.autonomyBody: Your store runs on your own domain, reflects your visual identity, and sends payouts straight to your bank account.

product.label: OPERATIONAL INTERFACE
product.title: A single place to manage your retail day.
product.subtitle: Clear views for orders, stock, and customer communication.

steps.label: ONBOARDING
steps.title: From catalog to checkout in three steps.
steps.step1Desc: Name your store, connect your domain, and choose a starting aesthetic.
steps.step2Desc: Upload photographs, assign variant options, and set transparent pricing.
steps.step3Desc: Connect your payment processor and begin taking orders immediately.

storefronts.label: STOREFRONT SHOWCASE
storefronts.title: Built on Snaker. Designed around your brand.
storefronts.description: Snaker provides the reliable backend infrastructure while you retain full control over your storefront presentation, typography, and customer experience.
storefronts.mobileReady: Responsive on every screen size without manual configuration.

performance.label: INFRASTRUCTURE
performance.title: Fast for your customers, handled for you.
performance.description: Storefront pages are pre-rendered and served from edge locations nearest to your buyers. Fast loading times lead to fewer abandoned carts without you needing to manage server configurations.

pricing.label: COMMERCIAL PLANS
pricing.title: Straightforward pricing for real businesses.
pricing.subtitle: Choose the level that fits your current operational scale.
pricing.starterDesc: For individuals and new businesses launching their first catalog.
pricing.businessDesc: For active retail stores requiring higher volume and automated workflows.
pricing.proDesc: For established merchants and multi-brand retail operations.

faq.label: QUESTIONS & ANSWERS
faq.title: Frequently asked questions.
faq.subtitle: Clear answers regarding store ownership, payments, and setup.

demo.label: SCHEDULE A CONVERSATION
demo.title: See Snaker with your business in mind.
demo.description: Share your current store details or business concept. We will walk you through a tailored demonstration of the platform.
demo.sellingLabel: What type of products do you sell?
demo.successMsg: Thank you. Our team will review your details and contact you shortly.

cta.title: Start your store on Snaker.
cta.description: Join merchants who value focused tools, transparent pricing, and design independence.

footer.tagline: A focused ecommerce platform built for modern retail operations.
